## SW I&I Working Practices Overview

These pages are designed to describe the general principles and ways of work at how analytical projects are managed and developed within the team.

It is recognised that not all projects are the same, this is a flexible framework that can be applied across all pieces of work and provide appropriate levels of assurance that the work is robust, accessible and of good quality.

There are sections developed to support good practice across the entire analytical pipeline and the goal is to set ourselves as a gold standard for analytical practices and processes to support healthcare within the region.
